content_text:
Dear Roger and other forum members,
Had a question to ask, and hoping to get good advice and tips from all of you. I find it challenging to give precise marks and maintain consistent eye lines when shooting a short reverse shot, especially if it’s against two different backgrounds, and two different times.
what I try and do is place a stand in at a similar position, relative to the Camera in the previous shot and then do it by eye.
what are some of the ways you go about giving a precise eye lines to the actors?
Looking forward to reading about your different processes,
Thank you,
Vashistha Pradhan
